scope: Conditional private first normal log-bringup candidate; no device admission or failed-load acceptance
kernel_format: one deterministic gzip ARM64 Image, zero alignment padding, one own-source hvt DTB
kernel_entry: ram_base plus fresh Image text_offset; validate 2MiB base and 512KiB entry alignment
runtime_placement: Fresh Image image_size must fit observed RAM and avoid every firmware reservation, initramfs and DT placement
logging: Nonce-bound bounded /dev/kmsg stream; durable host identity before ACK and fsync each record; no deliberate failure in first trial
limitations: Selected loader windows establish conditional capacity, not whole-firmware execution
First runtime USB, policy and kernel entry remain untested
Boot tail/header differences require complete candidate and rollback review before p5 write
A failure preceding log initialization is outside stream coverage
Recovery and boot full backups retained; recovery partition must never be written
